title: Malibu Comics Bravura Preview Book 1995 Comic Book #1 - Dan Brereton Kara Lamb
descriptionText: The Malibu Comics Bravura Preview Book 1995 Comic Book #1 features the artwork and writing of Jim Starlin, known for his work in the US Comics tradition. The story follows the character Breed in the Malibu universe, published by Malibu Comics. This vintage single issue from the Modern Age era offers action-packed superhero adventures in English language, making it a sought-after collectible for comic book enthusiasts.
